The structure of LiMn2O3F4 crystallizes in triclinic symmetry with space group P1 and a 10-atom unit cell containing Li, Mn, O, and F distributed across 10 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only analysis identifies octahedral coordination for both Li and Mn centers, each surrounded by six neighbors; Li is coordinated by four F and two O, while Mn is coordinated by four F and two O. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 10 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing relations include edge-sharing between Li and Mn octahedra and corner- and edge-sharing among Mn octahedra.
